# NOVRIX

NOVRIX is an on-chain intelligence terminal built for crypto traders, researchers, and analysts. It aggregates market data from multiple sources into a unified interface with three core analytical modules.

## What NOVRIX Is

An open-source web application that provides real-time and historical on-chain intelligence. The platform collects data from blockchain networks, exchange APIs, and market aggregators to present actionable metrics through interactive charts, tables, and a command-line interface.

## The Three Modules

### 1. Sentiment Intelligence (SE-01)
Market psychology indicators and macroeconomic overlays. 17 active metrics including:
- NUPL (Net Unrealized Profit/Loss)
- MVRV-Z Score
- NRPL (Net Realized Profit/Loss)
- Fear & Greed Index
- Pi Cycle Top Indicator
- 2-Year MA Multiplier
- Bitcoin Halving markers
- Macroeconomic overlays (FRED data)

Data sources: Glassnode, Alternative.me, FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data), CoinGecko.

### 2. Tracking Intelligence (TR-02)
Whale monitoring and significant capital movement tracking across 12 blockchain networks:
- Exchange flow analysis (inflow/outflow)
- Entity registry with labeled addresses
- Real-time large transaction feed
- Address-level deep dives
- Weekly volume charts
- Transaction flow visualization

Supported chains: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche, Fantom, zkSync Era, Linea.

### 3. Metrilytics Intelligence (ME-03)
DeFi protocol analytics and market health metrics:
- Total Value Locked (TVL) tracking
- Protocol revenue analysis
- Yield opportunity scanning
- Liquidity depth metrics
- Derivative positioning data
- Protocol health scores

Data sources: DeFiLlama, CoinGecko, Binance, direct RPC node queries.

## Platform Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Data Layer**: REST API with Redis caching, WebSocket for real-time feeds
- **Authentication**: NOVRIX ID system with 12-digit numeric access keys
- **CLI**: Global command-line interface accessible via keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + K)
- **Terminal**: Dark-mode precision interface with multi-panel layouts

## Open Source

NOVRIX is open source. The codebase is available for audit, contribution, and self-hosting. The platform operates on community contributions and maintains no corporate affiliation or venture capital backing.

## Data Sources

- Glassnode (on-chain metrics)
- DeFiLlama (DeFi protocol data)
- CoinGecko (market prices and metadata)
- Binance (exchange data and derivatives)
- FRED (macroeconomic indicators)
- Direct RPC nodes (12 blockchain networks)
- Blockchain explorers (transaction data)

## Site Structure

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| / | Homepage — Platform overview and module previews |
| /sentiment | Sentiment Intelligence module |
| /tracking | Tracking Intelligence module |
| /metrilytics | Metrilytics Intelligence module |
| /terminal | Terminal gateway (module selection) |
| /insights | Editorial content and market analysis |
| /about | Platform information and mission |
| /documentation | User guide and feature documentation |
| /methodology | Data sources and calculation methods |
| /changelog | Development history and releases |
| /donations | Community funding page |

## Key Facts

- Built and maintained by a single developer
- No external investment or corporate backing
- Free to use, funded by community donations
- All data is aggregated from public sources
- No proprietary trading algorithms
- No user funds are handled
- No KYC required
